analysis.title: USA: Where is the Crowd Positioned Ahead of Results? Stock insights for HF and LO
key_insights: Hedge funds are net long crowded into US names reporting this week, with a crowding score of +9.6 for those names versus +1.2 for the broader region.
Short hedge fund crowded names reporting this week (score below -7): FUBO, VVV, WMT.
Very heavily long hedge fund crowded names reporting this week (score above +21): DIS, INTU, KEYS, NVDA, WMG.

Positioning tailwind list: hedge fund crowded longs where mutual funds are underweight include AMZN, BAC, BRK/B, COST, CVX, DIS, ET, FTNT, LMT, META, MMM, MO, MSFT, NEM, OXY, PG, PSX, PYPL, RTX, TSLA.
DOW and GD are no longer among the top 3 hedge fund crowded longs and mutual fund underweights.
earnings_insights: Names reporting this week with extreme hedge fund crowding: long crowded DIS, INTU, KEYS, NVDA, WMG; short crowded FUBO, VVV, WMT. The note gives no EPS or revenue estimates or results.
risk_factors: Crowded long positioning ahead of earnings in DIS, INTU, KEYS, NVDA and WMG raises the risk of sharp moves if results disappoint.
